senses.definition: To go from one place to another, especially over a long distance or to another country.

examples.text: سَافَرَ أَحْمَدُ إِلَى لُبْنَانَ فِي الصَّيْفِ.
examples.translation: Ahmad traveled to Lebanon in the summer.
examples.emotion: lighthearted and pleasant, recalling a happy holiday trip

draftBefore.shortGloss: to travel; to go from place to place
draftBefore.emotion: wide-eyed and eager, thinking of a new adventure in another country
notes: Used when someone moves from one location to another, usually over a long distance.
Commonly followed by the preposition 'ila' (to) to indicate the destination: 'saafara ila dubayy' (he traveled to Dubai).

senses.definition: To go from one place to another, often by plane, train, or car, especially across long distances.
